readings.D1: Accepted. It keeps every guarantee of handoff section 5 (no client reading is read anywhere; old entry points unchanged; reading recomputed on every evaluation on the canonical row; historicalStateOf reproduces the live read; replay identity unchanged) and is better than the handoff's design on merged rows (verified: app report + device import read once, DISTANCE/MEASURED, either order, also across two reviews). New risks, none blocking: an exported capability on every entry point, DISTANCE trusted over completed:false, the mutable row passed to the reader (A-08); the fail-closed exception path works but is untested (M17).
